name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 26, 2020 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the August 12, 2020 Special Meeting- Closed Session and August 12, 2020 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-08-26 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Allsup
Approve the Warrants.
2020-08-26 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Adoption of Ordinance 2020-12 amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 2.12 Conflict of Interest Code. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Ordinance 2020-12 entitled, “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapter 2.12 regarding Conflict of Interest filers.”
2020-08-26 Item 08C City Conflict of Interest Code amendments
8D.
Reject all bids and rebid the Senior Center Courtyard Improvement Project and Equipment Project PR-RFB-20-04. Contact Person: Acting Director of Parks, Recreation and Cultural Arts Karlen
1) Reject all bids from the bid opening for the Senior Center Courtyard Improvement and Equipment Project PR-RFB-20-04; and 2) Authorize staff to re-advertise and re-bid the Senior Center Courtyard Improvement Project.
2020-08-26 Item 08D Reject all bids and rebid the Senior Center Courtyard Improvement Project
8E.
Notice of Completion for the Citywide Pavement Overlay Project FY 2018-2019 (CS19A). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
Adopt Resolution No. 2020-67 accepting the public improvements for the Citywide Pavement Overlay Project FY 2018-2019 (CS19A) as complete to the satisfaction of the City; authorizing the filing of the Notice of Completion for the Project; authorizing the release of the payment bond in full upon the recording of the Notice of Completion; and authorizing the release of the performance bond in full one (1) year after the recording of the Notice of Completion.
2020-08-26 Item 08E NOC Citywide Pavement Rehab Project FY 18-19
8F.
Approval of plans and specifications, and authorization to advertise Phase 1 of the Leucadia Streetscape project (CS04D). Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
1) Approve the plans, in substantial conformance with Attachment 1 of the agenda report, and specifications, in substantial conformance with Attachment 2 of the agenda report, for Phase 1 of the Leucadia Streetscape project (CS04D); and 2) Authorize the advertisement for construction bids of Phase 1 of the Leucadia Streetscape project (CS04D).
2020-08-26 Item 08F Approval of Plans and Specifications Phase 1 Leucadia Streetscape - Agenda Report
2020-08-26 Item 08F Approval of Plans and Specifications Phase 1 Leucadia Streetscape - Attachment 1
2020-08-26 Item 08F Approval of Plans and Specifications Phase 1 Leucadia Streetscape - Attachments 2-3
8G.
Consideration of an Exclusive Negotiating Agreement with Encinitas Arts, Culture and Ecology Alliance (EACEA) on the Pacific View Property. Contact Person: Interim City Manager Campbell
Authorize the Mayor to execute the attached 90-day Exclusive Negotiating Agreement (ENA), in substantial form subject to the review and approval by the City Attorney, with the EACEA (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2020-08-26 Item 08G Consideration of an ENA with EACEA on the Pacific View Property
8H.
Authorization to submit an application for the CalRecycle Reuse Grant Program. Contact Person: Management Analyst Stratakis
1) Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to apply for funding from the CalRecycle Reuse Grant Program to assist the City of Encinitas with reducing single-use product usage and working toward zero waste goals within the Climate Action Plan; and 2) Adopt Resolution Number 2020-74 Authorizing Submittal of Application for CalRecycle payment programs and related authorizations (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2020-08-26 Item 08H CalRecycle Reuse Grant Application
8I.
Bid rejection and authorization to re-scope and re-advertise the Trail 95 (CP00F) Project. Contact Person: Associate Engineer Kirk
1) Reject all bids from the bid opening for the Trail 95 (CP00F) Project; and 2) Authorize staff to re-scope and re-advertise the Trail 95 (CP00F) Project.
2020-08-26 Item 08I Trail 95 bid rejection
8J.
Memorandum of Agreement Between the City of Encinitas and WILDCOAST for the Installation and Use of a Marine Monitoring (M2) Radar for Tracking Illegal Fishing in the Swami’s State Marine Conservation Area. Contact Person: Coastal Zone Program Administrator Timberlake
Authorize the Interim City Manager to execute a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) between the City of Encinitas and WILDCOAST for the installation and use of a Marine Monitoring (M2) radar in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, in consultation with the City Attorney.
2020-08-26 Item 08J M2 Radar Monitoring MOA with WildCoast
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Education and enforcement of facial covering requirement of County Public Health Order. Contact Person: Assistant City Manager Delin
Authorize the City Manager to implement a three-month pilot program for as-needed facial covering education, compliance, and enforcement.
2020-08-26 Item 10A Facial Covering Education and Enforcement
10B.
Introduction of Ordinance No. 2020-13 for amendments to Title 11 of the Encinitas Municipal Code to prohibit the sale and distribution of flavored tobacco products in the City of Encinitas and increase the minimum age in accordance with new Federal law. Contact Person: Planner IV Zornes
1) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2020-13 titled “An Ordinance of The City of Encinitas Adopting Amendments to Title 11 of The Encinitas Municipal Code to Prohibit the Sale and Distribution of Flavored Tobacco Products in the City of Encinitas.” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report)
2020-08-26 Item 10B Flavored Tobacco Prohibition
10C.
Introduction of Ordinance No. 2020-15 amending Title 6 and Title 15 of the Encinitas Municipal Code to identify the City Manager, or designee, as the Issuing Authority for specific Operations Permits and to implement a Sidewalk Vending Operations Program; and review a proposed Sidewalk Vending Operations Permit Policy regulating the time, place and manner of sidewalk vending operations in the
City of Encinitas in compliance with Senate Bill 946 (Government Code sections 51036-51039), in the interest of protecting the public health, safety and welfare. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2020-15 titled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Titles 6 and 15 of the Encinitas Municipal Code Relating to Issuing Authority for Operations Permits and Implementing a Sidewalk Vending Operations Program;” (Attachment 1 of the Agenda Report) and 2) Review proposed Policy titled “Sidewalk Vending Operations Permit Policy.” (Attachment 2 of the Agenda Report)
2020-08-26 Item 10C Sidewalk Vending Ordinance Introduction
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council Member Initiated Item from Council Member Kranz regarding Adding Neighborhood Notification to All Way Stop Control Consideration.
Direction to Staff - When AWSC's are being considered, the flow of information and notification should be the same as it is for Speed Cushions. The Flow Chart, which includes neighborhood notifications being mailed to every homeowner, is included as Attachment 2 (of the agenda report).
2020-08-26 Item 12A Council Initated Item from Council Member Kranz
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON SEPTEMBER 9, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
